entries.query: Celtic Sea hake catch length weight age stage composition
entries.finding: Scattered 1994/1999/2000 Northern hake discard samples and metier-specific lengths; countries/gears and stock differ; not compatible 2019 whole-LME caught-mass adult/juvenile fractions. Search text reviewed; no new extraction adopted.

entries.query: Celtic Sea anglerfish catch age composition
entries.finding: 2005 stock/fishery age-length material, lacking source adult/juvenile threshold and 2019 whole-LME population.

entries.query: Celtic Sea cod catch at age mean weights
entries.finding: Older VIIe–k stock catch-at-age/weights; target/reference population and source stage definition do not match.
2019 advice Northern stock encompasses Greater North Sea/Celtic Seas/northern Bay Biscay; aggregate advice not a matching whole-LME stage mass population; source stage cutoff absent.

entries.query: Celtic Sea 2019 caught length biomass composition
entries.finding: 2013–2017 fleet/region size patterns, not the complete 2019 target caught mass. Illustrates changing fleet/size mixture; no compatible fixed allocation retrieved.

entries.query: Celtic Sea mixed fisheries retained catch species composition
entries.finding: French fisheries fine-scale retained catch composition; country/gear/space population differs from whole LME. Does not identify all broad catch-label species shares.
21cm maximum supports small benthic analogue rather than provider large reef tag.
Benthic shelf/upper slope; no source roughshark group. Both demersal shark guilds retained; no unsupported exact diet claim.

outcome: No matching complete caught-mass size/stage/species composition was recovered; accepted complete source B3 guild catches are Medium allocation proxies. This is not an exhaustive absence claim.
